topic: How sleep debt builds over a week

scenes.line: Sleeping 6 hours when you need 8? Watch your week.
scenes.visual: Sleep monitor panel with a moon icon and a big readout '6h' next to a dimmer target '8h'
scenes.animation: Panel powers on; '6h' flicks in on '6'; target '8h' slides in on '8'; a row of five small day dots pops on 'week'

scenes.line: Sleep debt is the gap between the sleep you need and the sleep you get.
scenes.visual: Two vertical bars: a tall outline bar labelled NEED and a shorter teal bar labelled GOT; the gap at the top of GOT glows apricot labelled DEBT
scenes.animation: NEED bar grows from 0 on 'need'; GOT bar grows on 'get'; apricot gap fades in with a pulse on 'gap'

scenes.line: Need 8 hours but get 6? That's 2 hours of debt that day.
scenes.visual: One night bar with a dashed target line at 8h; the teal fill stops at 6h; the apricot gap between them is labelled '2h debt'
scenes.animation: Target line draws on '8'; fill rises from 0 on '6', power2.out; apricot gap block pops with back.out on '2'

scenes.line: Do that for 5 days, and the debt grows to 10 hours.
scenes.visual: Five day columns labelled M T W T F, each with a small apricot debt block; on the right a tall debt meter that fills up to a readout '10h'
scenes.animation: Day columns stagger in 0.12 s apart on '5'; each apricot block drops into the meter; meter readout counts up and lands on '10h' on '10'

scenes.line: As it builds, your brain and body work less well.
scenes.visual: Brain icon and body outline side by side, each with a small level bar that drops from teal to apricot
scenes.animation: Icons fade up on 'brain' and 'body'; level bars shrink on 'less well', power2.inOut

scenes.line: You may feel tired and sleepy during the day.
scenes.visual: A sun icon over a calm face with half-closed eyes and three soft 'z' letters drifting up
scenes.animation: Sun rises on 'day'; eyelids lower on 'tired'; z letters float up and fade, stagger 0.2 s, on 'sleepy'

scenes.line: Paying it all back later is risky. Even when sleepiness fades, you may not be at your best.
scenes.visual: Two gauge rows on a panel: SLEEPINESS returns to the teal normal line, while FOCUS stays below its line in apricot; a small 'later' calendar badge with a caution mark
scenes.animation: Calendar badge pops on 'later', caution mark wiggles on 'risky'; sleepiness bar settles back on 'fades'; focus bar stops short on 'best'

scenes.line: Good news: you don't need to repay it hour for hour.
scenes.visual: A row of hour blocks with the words 'hour for hour' struck through; a soft deep-sleep wave beneath
scenes.animation: Blocks slide in on 'repay'; strike line draws across on 'hour', power2.out; wave draws on 'news'

scenes.line: If you were short last night, allow extra time and go to bed a little earlier.
scenes.visual: Clock face with a moon; the bedtime hand rotates back a little; a bed icon glows teal
scenes.animation: Clock fades up on 'night'; hand rotates back on 'earlier', power2.inOut; bed glows on 'bed'
scenes.onScreenText: Go to bed a bit earlier

scenes.line: Save this, and talk to a doctor if you feel tired all the time.
scenes.visual: Bookmark icon card and a speech bubble card reading 'Ask a doctor'
scenes.animation: Bookmark bounces on 'save'; speech bubble pops on 'doctor', back.out
